$comment: Verdicts GitHub Actions owes ci for the window it refused every job (GarrettMakesItLLC/platform#998), and how each is repaid. A `paid` records the run that measured it, the main SHA and the result; a red result counts as a payment when it names the issue it filed. Keep `.claude/fleet-mode.json` on `degraded` until every item here is paid.

items.verdict: One self-check.yml run of main on Actions: actionlint as raven-actions runs it, the post-deploy-probe fixtures, and every fixture job through the real runner.
items.why: The replica cannot run a reusable workflow, so probe-fixture-good/bad are NOT-RUN in every window report, and run-composite.py is a model of the runner rather than the runner.
items.howToPay: Actions → Self check → Run workflow on main. Record the run URL, the SHA and its conclusion.

paid.result: red, attributed: every lint/fixture job passed except two defects in the self-check itself — the known-bad probe fixture made every run red by design, and `v1 covers main` raced the same push's Release. Both fixed by the PR that records this payment.

items.verdict: The release.yml run that moves v1 over every change merged to main during the window, then one consumer PR per changed action proving it on that consumer's CI.
items.why: Consumers pin @v1, so a window merge reaches nobody until the tag moves, and the repo's own rule is that a tag moves only once a real consumer has run the commit.
owedFor: actions/ and .github/workflows/ changes merged during the window
items.howToPay: Point one consumer's workflow at main's SHA in a PR and let its CI run; once green, run Release. Record both run URLs, then run the v1-current job.

paid.run: https://github.com/GarrettMakesItLLC/ci/actions/runs/36801031383 (Release moved v1 to 4d03556); consumer on v1: https://github.com/GarrettMakesItLLC/RedThreadEvents/actions/runs/36813186073
paid.result: green: v1 == main, and a consumer's issue-status-clear.yml@v1 run succeeded against it
